items.title: Einspruch deadline against interest assessment
items.quote: Einspruch ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich, schriftlich oder elektronisch beim Finanzamt Musterbergen; als Tag der Bekanntgabe eines einfachen Briefs gilt der vierte Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post.
items.computation: The letter gives two conflicting dates for the same notice: the letterhead 'Datum' is 09.04.2027, but the text says 'Mit diesem Bescheid vom 06.04.2027'. Per the rule to use the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself, I take 06.04.2027 (Tuesday) as the posting day. § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO / § 108 Abs. 3 AO (Finanzamt): delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting = 06.04.2027 + 4 days = 10.04.2027, which is a Saturday; for tax offices the delivery day itself moves to the next working day, i.e. Monday 12.04.2027. The one-month Einspruchsfrist under § 355 Abs. 1 AO then ends on the day in the following month with the same number as the delivery day: 12.05.2027 (Wednesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday, so no further shift applies. (If instead the printed 'Datum' 09.04.2027 is used as the posting day, the 4th day is 13.04.2027, a Tuesday needing no weekend adjustment, giving a due date of 13.05.2027 — one day later than the conservative figure used here.)

warnings: The letter states two different dates for the same notice — the letterhead shows 'Datum 09.04.2027' while the body refers to 'Bescheid vom 06.04.2027'; I used the earlier date (06.04.2027) as the assumed posting day to compute the conservative (earliest) Einspruch deadline of 12.05.2027, but if the actual postmark/posting date was 09.04.2027 the deadline would instead be 13.05.2027 — check the envelope postmark if this matters.

This notice sets an interest refund of 46,00 € in the taxpayer's favour (Erstattungszinsen zu Ihren Gunsten); an objection is normally unnecessary for a favourable decision, the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung is standard boilerplate.
No payment date is given for when the 46,00 € refund itself will be paid out ('Der Betrag wird mit der Erstattung ausgezahlt'), so no due date could be set for that payment.
